entries.text: Thank you for calling VeloFit. Your call may be recorded for quality assurance. Please wait while we connect you to the next available agent.
Thank you for holding. My name is Isaac, and you've reached VeloFit Customer Support. How can I help you today?
Hi... yes, hello. I... I have a return. I think. I'm not sure if I can, it's all very confusing.
I can certainly help you look into that. Could I start with your full name and the order number, please?
Yes, it's Maria Valenti. The order number is... uh... VF-881-2099. It's for a helmet.
Thank you, Maria. I see the order right here for the Aero-Dynamic Helmet. To make sure I understand, what specifically is the issue? Is it a technical fault or more of a preference?

Oh, I don't know. I guess a preference? The color on the website looked different. It's not what I expected at all. The box is still unopened, I never even touched it. I'm just so lost with all these rules. Can't you just help me?
Of course, Maria. I'm here to help. Let me just check the delivery date and our policy for you. I see it was delivered 56 days ago.
Is that bad? I wasn't sure. It's been a while.

Not at all. I've just confirmed our policy, and you're well within the 90-day return window for standard items. We can absolutely get that return processed for you. We want to make sure you're happy with your gear, especially when it comes to something as important as helmet safety and style.
Oh, really? That's such a relief! The website was so complicated, I thought I was stuck with it. Thank you.

You're very welcome. I'm emailing you a prepaid return label right now. Just attach that to the original shipping box and drop it off at your local post office. Once our warehouse receives it, we'll issue a full refund to your original payment method. Does that sound good?
Yes, that sounds perfect. Thank you so much, Isaac.
It was my pleasure, Maria. Is there anything else I can assist with today?
No, that was it. Thanks again.
Alright. Thank you for calling VeloFit. Have a wonderful day.
